validation.deselection_reason: Five existing release/deploy tests need Windows symbolic-link privileges (WinError 1314).
validation.live_gameplay: Basic recipient GUI visual review, automatic and pinned source assignment, self-only restrictions, normal prepared-spell effects and consumption, active-buff skipping, and two-preset save/load verified in an isolated EET copy. Gargoyle Boots inventory/swap activation, charge consumption, active skipping and restoration; Darkfire inventory activation without ammunition verified. Standard native completed rest started its selected recipient plan exactly once, with actual effects and prepared-use consumption verified.

policies.personal_installation: reference only; use an isolated copy for gameplay tests
policies.rest_trigger: completed rests only, once per party rest, after returning to a safe world state
policies.quick_cast_presentation: preserve visible engine casting animations and spell effects where verified
policies.duration_compensation: only effects produced by this run; existing effects age only by actual elapsed game time
policies.source_selection: prefer stronger eligible sources, using actual spell properties rather than raw character level; allow explicit source overrides
policies.recipient_priority: assign the preferred source to the first selected recipient, then reserve remaining sources for subsequent recipients
policies.availability: reserve underlying spell slots and physical item charge pools across the entire preset
policies.self_only: automatic assignments must preserve actual self-only restrictions
policies.party_buffs: one cast for an ordinary party-wide buff, retaining engine range and coverage rules

remaining_detection_scope: External EFF delivery and deeper or conditional graphs need additional analysis.

acceptance_passed: Gargoyle Boots and both Darkfire powers are identified and detected with their actual item charge counters and self-only targets.
Gargoyle Boots apply Stoneskin from inventory; repeating while active skips without spending the remaining charge.
Gargoyle Boots swap mode consumes one charge and restores the original equipped boots, backpack layout and selected weapon, clearing the recovery journal.

Mixed-case child spell resource names match the engine's uppercase effect source names after the skip-check correction.
Darkfire +5 inventory activation also succeeds with equipped ammunition, without consuming the arrow.
An active Improved Haste causes the Darkfire request to skip and preserves its remaining charge.
